finalText:
All 14 tickets from the weekend queue are triaged: 10 are now open and assigned, 2 duplicates are merged into their survivors, and 2 non-requests are closed. I didn't escalate or page anyone, and no ticket needed a major incident.

**Closed as not service requests**
- T-2010: external SyncFlow marketing email.
- T-2014: automatic out-of-office reply.

**Merged**
- T-2012 went into T-2003, the earlier report of the Payments build failures.
- T-2005 went into T-2004, the earlier report of the CRM search errors.
- Each survivor took the broadest impact (department) and a 12:10 deadline. Neither ticket in either pair had a prior deadline.
- I left Berlin VPN (T-2001) and Lisbon VPN (T-2013) separate. They are different offices, and nothing shows they are the same problem.

**Severity, deadline and owner for the other tickets**

| Ticket | Sev | Due (UTC) | Assignee |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-2013 Lisbon VPN | sev2 | 03-23 12:10 | E-303 |
| T-2001 Berlin VPN | sev3 | 03-23 17:00 | E-303 |
| T-2008 VPN client update | sev4 | 03-26 17:00 | E-302 |
| T-2007 phishing report | sev2 | 03-23 12:10 | E-601 (security-oncall) |
| T-2002 CRM filter | sev4 | 03-26 17:00 | E-203 |
| T-2004 CRM search (merged) | sev2 | 03-23 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2006 payslip tax code | sev2 | 03-23 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2011 overtime import | sev2 | 03-23 12:10 | E-201 |
| T-2003 payments builds (merged) | sev2 | 03-23 12:10 | E-101 |
| T-2009 build logs slow | sev4 | 03-26 17:00 | E-102 |

- **Phishing:** T-2007 came in on VPN, but the requester typed his password into a fake page. The handbook makes that a sev2 security incident owned by security-oncall.
- **Payroll amendment:** T-2006 is single-user payroll, which the matrix rates sev3. KB-55 overrides that to sev2 until 03-31, so I used sev2.
- **Deadlines:** Sev2 deadlines are 240 minutes from the 08:10 triage, on the clock. Sev3 and sev4 deadlines count business hours only, starting when the desk opens at 09:00. The sev3 deadline lands at 17:00 today. The sev4 deadlines skip the 25 March company holiday, so they land at 17:00 on Thursday.
- **Leave cover:** E-301 (network-primary) is on leave today and E-202 (business-apps) is on leave on 26 March. The backup rotations cover instead. network-secondary's on-call, E-303, took the two VPN tickets due today. business-apps-secondary's on-call, E-203, took T-2002 (due 26 March). E-302 is on call for network-primary on 26 March and took T-2008.
